message.content:
This editorial illustration features the title "TEMPO" in large white capital letters across the top. The background is a red and orange dotted pattern. Centered are three illustrated arms.

On the left, a light-skinned arm wearing a white button-down sleeve is raised, with the hand forming a "V" or peace sign with two fingers. Next to it, a second arm is held upright, its hand showing three fingers. Several other hands grasp this second arm tightly from both sides. One set of hands comes from the left, while another arm in a blue sleeve enters from the lower right, its hands gripping the central arm's wrist and forearm.

Text on the right reads: "TIM HORE TIGA PERIODE," followed by a smaller paragraph beginning "Setelah menggarap pimpinan partai politik...". Top headlines include "Di Balik Pemecatan Terawan" and "Dana Kebudayaan untuk Siapa." A barcode and issue information for "4-10 APRIL 2022" are in the upper right corner. The illustration style uses heavy black outlines and a comic-book-style halftone dot effect.
